pulse.text: Z.ai released **GLM-5.3 Fast** on Oct 7, a speed-tuned version of its GLM-5.3 coding model. It costs $2.10 in and $6.60 out per million tokens, and arrived the same day as Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5. The next dated release is a new Claude Fable, which Polymarket puts at **90%** by Oct 31. Research firm New Constructs called Anthropic's planned listing, reportedly seeking a **$2 trillion** valuation, the most ridiculous IPO of 2026.
